manual: Build with community-apps/hype/install.sh (CMake). Stock Devuan Excalibur Qt 6.8 is enough; upstream asks for 6.9 (see README.md for what differs on 6.8).
ffmpeg exports animated slides; source-highlight colours code blocks.
Open/save dialogs use the desktop portal (xdg-desktop-portal-gtk on i3).
Tests (bin/test) also need qt6-pdf-dev, python3, fonts-noto-core and fonts-jetbrains-mono.
